scene: The drone beeps happily and drops a glowing passcard on the platform.
picture: A flat side view along the rooftop platform. On the far left stands a blue speed-booster ramp. The player in her red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands centre-left facing right. In the centre, a glowing neon passcard lies on the floor. Right of centre, the friendly drone hovers. On the far right waits an open glass elevator.
